mail_outbox_data_lifetime.name: mail_outbox_data_lifetime
mail_outbox_data_lifetime.value: ("mail_outbox"."status" IN ('pending', 'sending') AND "mail_outbox"."data" IS NOT NULL) OR ("mail_outbox"."status" = 'sent' AND "mail_outbox"."data" IS NULL) OR "mail_outbox"."status" = 'failed'

site_builds_result_valid.name: site_builds_result_valid
site_builds_result_valid.value:
("site_builds"."status" = 'succeeded') = ("site_builds"."release" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("site_builds"."status" = 'failed') = ("site_builds"."error" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("site_builds"."status" IN ('succeeded', 'failed')) = ("site_builds"."finished_at" IS NOT NULL)
